A '''Beast Rider''' accompanied [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Gobee]] in the defense of [[Kira Fortress]], the forest stronghold of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon's]] [[Beast Riders|Beast Rider]] society. Stationed in the planet's wilderness, this Beast Rider and Gobee maintained the security around the perimeter of Fortress Kira, while [[Beast-Lord]] [[Oron Kira]] [[Binding Ceremony of Oron Kira and Galia|married]] [[Galia]], [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] of Onderon's only [[City/Legends|city]] called [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]].
